name: outbound-engine
description: 25 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting). Master skill `signal-outbound` runs the full path: service page → signal catalog → scored account list from ATS job postings → named contacts with verified emails → sequence → personalization pipeline → launch, enforcing a gate between steps. Plus signal detection, data research, waterfall enrichment, lead scoring, hypothesis building, sequence copy, campaign tiering/naming/orchestration, deliverability audit, A/B analysis, campaign and weekly reports, and forensic reply audits. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
